# Amazon Widget Store limits

Amazon Widget Store keeps widgets on shelves. This page describes the resources of the service and their limits.

## Shelves

A shelf is a Regional resource. A shelf stores widgets in one AWS Region.
Each shelf can hold up to 500 widgets.
By default, a new shelf is private and only its owner can read it.
You cannot move a shelf to another Region. To use another Region, copy the shelf.

## Crates

A crate is a container for widgets that you ship between Regions.
A crate can hold up to 50 widgets.
Widget Store deletes an empty crate after 7 days.

## Quotas

| Resource | Default | Adjustable |
|---|---|---|
| Shelves per Region | 20 | Yes |
| Widgets per shelf | 500 | No |
| Crates per account | 5 | Yes |

## Document history

| Change | Description | Date |
|---|---|---|
| Shelf capacity increased | The maximum number of widgets per shelf increased from 200 to 500. | November 19, 2025 |
